consumer: workers/main.py validates and normalizes the level and passes it to RQ Worker.work(logging_level=...). Structured operation logging remains independently configured.

validation.scope: Only rendered worker log-level keys inspected; synthetic required environment values, no containers started.

remaining_criteria.finding: The flag is validated and returned by /settings but no notification behavior consumer was found in frontend/API/services/workers.
Mock submission and manual auth use the fixed per-application browser-profile directory; no ordinary UI/environment profile configuration is connected.

Submission admission uses immutable Policy defaults (3/hour, 10/day, 1/company). Controlled-dry-run controls provide a separate per-application per-UTC-day API limit, without a UI/environment setting.

limits: This narrow deployment configuration fix does not close whole MJ-REQ-275.
No paid providers, external application submissions, or production settings were invoked.
Private environment overlays remain separately protected; the existing backup nonsecret runtime allowlist is unchanged.
